title: Move the begin-preparation decision code out of engram_host_adapter.rs's dispatch loop into engram_begin_preparation_retry.rs
outcome: About 120 lines of begin-preparation decision code leave the dispatch loop in engram_host_adapter.rs for a helper in engram_begin_preparation_retry.rs that returns a small decision enum. Behaviour is unchanged, as a pure code move per CLAUDE.md. The moved code: the pending lookup, the kind selection, the mapping from failure to card code, the branch that keeps an unsent Begin pending while the budget is enforced, and the swap of Rejected for PersistenceUnknown on settlement.
acceptance: Move the begin-preparation decision code out of engram_host_adapter.rs's dispatch loop into engram_begin_preparation_retry.rs is done
